c4x.ai.apiKey.description:
DEPRECATED. API keys are stored in VS Code's encrypted SecretStorage, not in settings.

To add or replace a key, run 'C4X: Set Gemini API Key' from the Command Palette (Cmd+Shift+P). To remove one, run 'C4X: Clear Gemini API Key'.

Any value left here is migrated to secure storage and cleared on next activation.

c4x.ai.model.description:
Gemini model ID for AI diagram generation. Enter any model ID your API key supports.

Verified 2026-09-05:
- gemini-3.8-flash — newest generally available flash (default)
- gemini-3.7-flash — previous generation, still generally available
- gemini-3.6-flash — previous default, still generally available
- gemini-3.1-flash-lite — budget option
- gemini-3.1-pro-preview — best reasoning, used as failover. Preview: no generally available Pro exists in the 3.x line

See https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models for all available models.

c4x.ai.imageModel.description:
Gemini model ID for visual PNG diagram generation. Enter any image-capable model ID your API key supports.

Verified 2026-08-07:
- gemini-3.1-flash-image — Nano Banana 2, fast (default)
- gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image — Nano Banana 2 Lite, lowest latency and cost
- gemini-3-pro-image — Nano Banana Pro, highest quality

See https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/image-generation for details.

c4x.ai.visualGroundingContext.description: Custom visual style context for PNG diagram generation (max 300 chars). This text is injected into the AI prompt to guide the visual style. Leave empty to use preset or default. Example: 'Dark theme with neon accents, transparent background, cyberpunk aesthetic'

c4x.ai.visualPreset.description:
Visual style preset for PNG diagrams.

• default — Clean white background, standard C4 colors
• dark — Dark background, white/cyan text, neon accents
• light — Bright white, high contrast, professional
• pastel — Soft pastel palette, rounded corners, gentle aesthetic
• corporate — Professional grey-blue palette, sharp edges, business-ready

Note: Custom 'visualGroundingContext' overrides this preset.

c4x.ai.layoutPreference.description:
Layout spacing preference for PNG diagrams.

• balanced — Standard spacing (default)
• compact — Tighter spacing, more elements on screen
• spacious — Generous padding, larger arrows, better readability

c4x.layout.persistence.description:
Specify where visual layout adjustments are saved.

• native — Writes coordinates directly into native C4X files using $x, $y and $locked comments. Automatically falls back to sidecar for Structurizr or PlantUML formats (default).
• sidecar — Writes all visual layout coordinates to a central .c4x-layout.json file in the workspace root or document directory.

c4x.layout.spacing.description:
Spacing between elements in automatic diagram layout.

• compact — Tighter spacing (40/60px), more elements on screen
• balanced — Standard spacing (60/80px, default)
• spacious — Generous spacing (90/120px), better readability

Groups with three or fewer children are automatically tightened by 25% to reduce empty space in small diagrams.

c4x.edgesOnTop.description: Render relationship arrows above diagram nodes so connectors stay visible over large containers and deployment nodes (default). Set to false to paint edges behind nodes (legacy behaviour).

c4x.legend.show.description: Show the diagram legend overlay in the preview (default). The legend floats over the canvas — drag it or use arrow keys to reposition — and lists only the element types present in the current diagram. Set to false to hide it entirely.

c4x.canvas.autoFitOnOpen.description: Automatically zoom the preview to fit the whole diagram when it is first opened (default). Set to false to open at 1:1, centred on the diagram. Save-triggered refreshes never re-fit the canvas.

c4x.markdown.previewScale.description: Scale factor for C4X diagrams embedded in Markdown preview. 0.5 renders diagrams at half their intrinsic size. Changes apply on the next Markdown preview refresh.

enumDescriptions: Use exactly the model in c4x.ai.model. If it has been retired or your key cannot reach it, fall back to the newest generally available model in the same tier and tell you.
Automatically use the newest generally available model in the tier, so a new Gemini release is picked up without updating the extension. Preview and experimental models are never selected.
c4x.ai.modelStrategy.description: How C4X chooses a generation model.\n\nEither way, a model your key cannot reach is replaced rather than left to fail, and you are told when that happens. Run 'C4X: Select Gemini Model' to see what your key can use.

c4x.lint.enabled.markdownDescription: Check C4X diagrams against the C4 notation rules and list what is missing in the Problems panel: descriptions, technologies, relationship labels, external marking, elements at the wrong C4 level, and views that do not hang together (scope, duplicate names, relationships that reach into another container). Findings are advice only and never block the preview. See the [rule catalogue](https://github.com/jpantsjoha/c4x-vscode-extension/blob/main/docs/C4X-LINT-RULES.md).

c4x.lint.rules.markdownDescription: Severity per lint rule, keyed by rule id. `off` (or `ignore`) turns a rule off; `info`, `warning` and `error` set how its findings are reported. A rule left out runs at its default, which is `info` for every rule. Example: `{ "C4X-L003": "warning", "C4X-L008": "off" }`. See the [rule catalogue](https://github.com/jpantsjoha/c4x-vscode-extension/blob/main/docs/C4X-LINT-RULES.md).
